description: FIFA 15 Ultimate Team: New Season features over 10,000 players from over 500 licensed teams, with kits, balls, players, and boots from the 2015/2016 season. Plus, over 30 real leagues and stadiums! Build a dream squad of footballers and put them to the test. From the English Premier League, La Liga, and MLS, to the German Bundesliga and beyond. This app offers in-app purchases. You may disable in-app purchasing using your device settings. ** This is a highly detailed game of superior quality. Please make sure you have at least 1.35GB of free space on your device. ** BUILD YOUR ULTIMATE TEAM...
